steps.title: Populate empty pages via Jahia MCP (idempotent)
acceptance_criteria: IDEMPOTENT: for each path in orchestration/sitemaps/sial-paris.txt, check existence with MCP content.get (locale fr). If missing, page.create it; if present, REUSE the node - never recreate or duplicate. Node names are lowercase. Publish each page to live with publication.publish.

FULL FIDELITY, NOT A SUMMARY: reproduce EVERY section of the matching reference URL on https://www.sialparis.com/fr-FR with its REAL data - do not abridge. Where the reference shows a price matrix, use sialp:pricingTable + pricingTier with ACTUAL prices/labels (EARLY BIRD/STANDARD/LATE BIRD/ONSITE x Individuel/Groupe/VIP/Ecole, real EUR values). Where it shows expandable Q&A or conditions, use sialp:faqSection + faqItem with the REAL questions and answers. Where it shows team/experts/speakers, use sialp:peopleGrid + personCard. NEVER substitute a generic image+text block for a table or accordion. Transcribe all editorial text, every card and section heading.

MAP each section onto an existing sialp: type (run inventory.sh first). Add a view if markup differs but properties match. Do NOT invent new types. New components (FAQ accordion=faqSection/faqItem, pricing=pricingTable/pricingTier, people=peopleGrid/personCard) already exist - reuse them.

Use the Jahia MCP server (JSON-RPC at $JAHIA_HOST/modules/mcp, Authorization APIToken from project .env) for ALL content operations. content.create/content.update/publication.publish. GraphQL only if MCP cannot do an op; note any fallback in the summary.

IMAGES = DAM weakreferences, NEVER url strings (AGENTS.md 2a). Images are imported into the DAM via MCP media.upload.url (consistent UUID) - see orchestration/images/set_image_refs.py and set_hero_refs.py. Reference each via the component's WEAKREFERENCE field (image/backgroundImage/logo/photo) with setValue(type:WEAKREFERENCE). NEVER set imageExternalUrl/backgroundImageUrl/logoExternalUrl; if set, clear them. Do NOT fetch images (the site blocks the agent) - URLs are captured via browser into orchestration/images/<project>.json.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-new-types.sh projects/sial-paris sialp orchestration/component-baseline.txt
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/content.sh projects/sial-paris sial-paris fr @orchestration/sitemaps/sial-paris.txt 800
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-url-images.sh projects/sial-paris sial-paris sialp
